lines.en: I squirm my way along.

lines.zh: 我在土上留下一道浅痕。
lines.en: I leave a faint track in the dirt.
My body is smaller than a palm.
I crawl a circle around a pebble.
I head slowly for the grass roots.
I push forward segment by segment.
I slip under a leaf.
I shift half a block along the ground.
I lift my head, then crawl on.
I drag my soft body forward.
I find a way between clods of dirt.
I move bit by bit toward the light.
I slip into the grass nearby.
I go slowly around a pebble.
I crawl over damp soil.
I shift a little toward you.
I curl in the dirt, still.
My segments draw in.
I rest on a leaf, very light.
My eyes are barely visible.

lines.zh: 我把身体埋进松土，只露头。
lines.en: I bury myself in loose soil, only my head out.
I let out a slow breath.

lines.zh: 我缩在石子底下，听外面动静。
lines.en: I huddle under a stone and listen outside.
I daze among the grains of soil.
My body swells a bit.
I do not even lift my head.
I press against the soil and hold.

lines.zh: 我像一颗会动的小石子。
lines.en: I look like a pebble that moves.
I raise my little head to look at you.
You are so big that I am a little afraid.
I push a little your way.
I sway my head left and right.
I sniff the soil by your feet.

lines.zh: 我抬起前半身，又伏下去。
lines.en: I lift my front half, then settle again.
My body presses to the ground.

lines.zh: 我把头抬高一点，又缩回去。
lines.en: I raise my head a little, then pull it back.
I stop two blocks from you.
I am not sure whether to come over.
I roll my body into a ring.
I burrow half my body into the soil.
I squirm twice and stop.
One of my segments dents.
I shift away a little.
My head droops down.
My whole body is trembling.
I draw my body tighter.
I dare not move again.

lines.zh: 我连扭都没扭，就那么缩着。
lines.en: I don't even squirm; I just stay curled.
I crawl toward that thing.

lines.zh: 我先把它的周围绕一圈。
lines.en: I circle all around it first.

lines.zh: 我用嘴碰了碰，才敢下口。
lines.en: I touch it with my mouth before I dare bite.
I push it into the soil.

lines.zh: 我慢慢啃，边啃边看四周。
lines.en: I nibble slowly, watching around me.
I look up to see if there is more.
I drag it under a leaf.
I sniff once and withdraw.
It is bigger than I am.
I press against it and hold.
You step on me and I curl up.
I am rolled half a block.
I stick to the sole of your boot.
I scramble into the soil.
You kick me aside.
I crawl over the top of your foot.
My body gets squashed a little.
A little thing lies at your feet.
I shift away, uneasy.
I can barely feel the bump.
Two little grubs press together.
We curl into a small ring.

lines.zh: 我用触须绕住它的触须。
lines.en: I wrap my feelers around its feelers.

lines.zh: 它们慢慢地绕着彼此爬。
lines.en: They crawl slowly around each other.
We burrow into the soil together.
They stop head to head.
Neither of us moves.
A grain of soil lies between them.
We push forward together.

lines.zh: 我们的体节一节对着一节。
lines.en: Our segments line up one to one.
I open my mouth and take it.

lines.zh: 我把它压在身子底下藏好。
lines.en: I tuck it under my body to hide it.
I drag it along slowly.
I hide it under a leaf.
I try to swallow and get stuck.
I push it into the soil.
I curl my tail around it.
I let go and it rolls away.
I hold it and crawl slowly.
It fills my mouth completely.
I lift my head and look that way.
I feel the soil move.
I start crawling over there.
My body draws taut.
I head straight there.
I have picked a spot.
I stop taking the long way.
I lower my head and push forward.
Only that one thing is moving here.
I close on it bit by bit.

lines.zh: 土一颤，我的头就朝那边转。
lines.en: The soil shivers and my head turns that way.
I slowly speed up.
I have found a smell.
All my feelers point forward.
I follow that movement.
The moment it moves, I turn.
I circle it along the ground.

lines.zh: 我一节一节地追，绝不改方向。
lines.en: I chase segment by segment, never turning aside.

lines.zh: 我只剩两节身长的距离。
lines.en: Only two body-lengths remain.
I approach from another angle.
I slow down, very carefully.
I follow the grass roots forward.
I press my body even lower.
I hear it scrape the ground.
I shift through the grass.

lines.zh: 我隔着一片叶子，等它再动。
lines.en: I wait behind a leaf for it to move again.
I am about to bump into it.
I crawl toward the smell.

lines.zh: 我一头顶在它的脚趾上。
lines.en: I butt my head into its toe.
I press my whole body on it.
I take a small bite of it.
I coil around it and tighten.
It slides from my push.
I gnaw twice and withdraw.
I push it from underneath.
I drag it two blocks.

lines.zh: 我一口咬住它的脚踝不放。
lines.en: I bite its ankle and hold on.
My bite is very light.
A small head pokes out of the soil.
A small segmented shadow appears.

lines.zh: 我从石头的缝里挤出来。
lines.en: I squeeze out of a stone crack.
Something moves at your feet.
I begin crawling on the ground.
One segment shows first.

lines.zh: 我顶开一片落叶，探出头来。
lines.en: I push a leaf aside and poke my head out.
Soil crumbs roll aside.
I come out from under a leaf.
I crawl slowly into the light.
I curl up, my tail tip scorched.
I fall from above and go limp.

lines.zh: 我在水里乱扭着浮不起来。
lines.en: I thrash in the water and cannot rise.
The blast throws me into the air.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过我的一节身子。
lines.en: An arrow passes through one segment.

lines.zh: 我的身体僵住，一节也动不了。
lines.en: My body locks; not one segment will move.
Hunger leaves me unable to crawl.

lines.zh: 雷打在地上，我弹了起来。
lines.en: Lightning hits the ground and I spring up.

lines.zh: 下面的泥土没了，我掉了下去。
lines.en: The soil below is gone; I fall.
